cohort: 2838 women with singleton pregnancies who delivered in 2006 or 2011 at the University of Würzburg
finding: While pre-pregnancy BMI and weight gain during pregnancy did not increase significantly from 2006 to 2011, obesity was associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that obesity during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of delivery by cesarean section.
